about.sectionTitle: I like the whole path from blank file to shipped
paragraphs: I started with HTML and CSS, moved into JavaScript and React, then picked up Python and C/C++ to understand what happens underneath the browser. That mix means I can build an interface and also reason about the code that feeds it.

I care about pages that load quickly, work with a keyboard, and read well on a small screen. Outside of client work I write small tools for myself and read other people's code to learn how they solve problems.

projects.sectionDescription: A mix of client work, side projects, and coursework.

projectList.name: Bitmap Image Viewer
projectList.description: A simple BMP image viewer written in C using SDL2. This project focuses on parsing and rendering BMP files with support for multiple formats and compression types.

projectList.name: LC-3 Virtual Machine (Python)
projectList.description: A simple LC-3 (Little Computer 3) virtual machine implemented in Python. This project emulates the LC-3 architecture, including registers, memory, instruction set, and trap routines.

projectList.name: PH Acquired Properties Scraper
projectList.description: Scrapes publicly listed acquired/foreclosed real estate from four Philippine government and bank sources, combines them into one normalized dataset, and optionally loads everything into MySQL.

projectList.name: TLS Analyzer
projectList.description: A from-scratch, live TLS handshake inspector — built to learn packet capture, protocol parsing, and systems programming from the wire up.

projectList.name: WinEventHook
projectList.description: A lightweight Windows console application written in C using the Win32 API. WinEventHook records and replays keyboard and mouse input using low-level Windows hooks and SendInput().

projectList.name: Todo App
projectList.description: A responsive todo app built with React and Tailwind CSS. Supports adding, completing, deleting, and filtering todos, a persistent light/dark theme, and drag-and-drop reordering using the native HTML5 Drag and Drop API.

projectList.name: Weather App
projectList.description: A weather app built with vanilla JavaScript and the Open-Meteo API. Features city search with debounced autocomplete, current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecasts, and switchable metric/imperial units, all in a responsive layout.

projectList.name: Order Summary Card
projectList.description: A small order summary card built as a Flexbox layout exercise. Uses Flexbox for centering and stacking the card contents, with hover states on the interactive elements.

projectList.name: Interactive Rating Component
projectList.description: An interactive rating card with a "Thank you" state after submitting. Uses visually restyled radio buttons for single-select ratings and JavaScript to switch between states.

projectList.name: Bento Grid
projectList.description: A responsive bento grid layout built with CSS Grid. Uses named grid areas and media queries to rearrange the boxes across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

projectList.name: Age Calculator App
projectList.description: An age calculator that takes a birth date and shows the age in years, months, and days. Includes form validation for empty, out-of-range, invalid, and future dates, with a responsive layout.
